item.title: BizNode Launches Workflow Chains With BZeUSD Escrow and Full Rollback Semantics
item.summary: BizNode has launched workflow chains using /cw and /rw commands with BZeUSD escrow that enforces full rollback if any step fails, aiming to bring atomic transaction guarantees to multi-step agent-to-agent commerce — though no independent adoption data or security audits exist.
